basic_info.description: Unit 205, a spacious and light-filled corner one-bedroom, one-bath residence in the prestigious Cathedral Hill Apartments, is located in an iconic 1927 Art Deco building perched atop Nob Hill.     Offering exceptional value in a highly coveted location, this home blends timeless San Francisco elegance with modern comfort.    Step inside to discover high ceilings, beautiful hardwood floors, and expansive windows that flood the open concept living and dining areas with natural light. The stylish kitchen flows seamlessly into the living spaceideal for both daily living and entertaining. Designed with comfort in mind, the oversized bedroom easily fits a king-sized bed and includes dual walk-through closets that provide direct access to a sleek, modern bathroom.    Building amenities include a 24-hour doorman, onsite management, an elegant lobby with refined seating areas and elevator access, a rooftop terrace with sweeping views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Coit Tower, a landscaped garden terrace with multiple seating areas, EV-capable parking, additional storage, a dedicated mailroom, and on-site laundry facilities.    Unit 205 at 1201 California is more than a home  it's an opportunity to live in one of the city's most iconic neighborhoods.
